analysis_result.analysis: The model's reasoning collapsed at the perception stage: it misidentified the color arrangement of the reference cube (swapping red and blue between top and front faces). This led to a cascading grounding error — selecting Option A, which matched its hallucinated reference, rather than Option B, which correctly matched the actual reference cube described in the ground truth. The error is fundamental and not due to ambiguity or misinterpretation of options — the model simply saw the wrong colors on the wrong faces.
